unknown_customer_orders.question: How many orders has customer ZZZZZ placed?
unknown_customer_orders.cypher:
MATCH (c:Customer {customer_id: 'ZZZZZ'})-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)
RETURN count(o) AS order_count
LIMIT 100
unknown_customer_orders.synthesis_answer: Based on the graph evidence, customer ZZZZZ has placed 0 orders.
unknown_customer_orders.verdict: KNOWN GAP — misleading zero-count (same class as Employee/Invoice Section 12)
